title: Samogitians React to Laurinavičius' Winter Airplane
text:
“The manor comedian M. Laurinavičius was thrown out of the plane? Is the lost suitcase lost. Karma is karma! Such jokers need to run home on foot. I wonder if it disembarked it according to the list of L.Kaščiūnas suggested to shoot?
https://www.facebook.com/plugins/post.php?href=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.facebook.com%2FRemigijusZemaitaitis1%2Fposts%2Fpfbid0gvqTdfumwcBqse7hf4CVaKQNtKXCMspEPXkF5NZkzsn4rBpGRskqfSCZHqk8dm2kl&show_text=true&width=500" width="100%" height="250" style="border:none;overflow:hidden" scrolling="no" frameborder="0" allowfullscreen="true" allow="autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture; web-share
At least the unnecessary suitcase was thrown here.
PS usually disembarked intoxicated and screaming customers out of the plane, wondering what the latter version will be like? Drunk, noise or did not pass Face Control? ”, – writes R. Žemaitaitis in his Facebook account.
On Wednesday night, a plane transported to Vilnius from Israeli evacuated Lithuanians from Akaba Airport in Jordan. Before the flight, commentator M.Laurinavičius was landed from him. He told 15min that businessman Gediminas Winter gave such an order because he had previously criticized him for business in Russia.
15min Photo/Marius Laurinavičius
The evacuation flight is carried out by the chapman freeborn of Avia Solutions Group, managed by G. Wiemel.
According to Laurinavičius, the representatives of the company to which the plane belonged to him told him that the company had ordered him to land.
“They really behaved very correctly, very politely, said a very clear thing that they had no other way to land me because they got a ‘strict’ instruction for a company that ordered this trip. At the same time, they said they didn’t know any reason, it was nothing to do with the company itself, the one that owns the plane, nor the airport, that is, the direct order of the company that ordered this flight, which they simply cannot keep, ”the reviewer told LRT.
Vilma Vaitiekūnaitė, the head of Skylence, who serves private flights at Vilnius Airport, told BNS on Wednesday night that Laurinavičius was landed from the plane. According to her, this will be explained when he returns to Vilnius.
Lukas April / BNS Photo /vilma Vaitiekūnaitė
“We only know that the terrestrial service company has questions about the operator’s data provided,” said V.Vaitiekūnaitė.
According to her, there was no time and opportunity to find out on the spot, so it was decided to leave one person so that others could be brought home on Wednesday.
A NKVC spokesman said the center is also explaining what happened, trying to help M. Laurinavičius to come to Lithuania.
According to Darius Buta, it was contacted by the company, which operates a flight to Lithuania and was asked to explain the situation. Lithuanian diplomats help M. Laurinavičius from the region.
Lithuanian Foreign Minister Kęstutis Budrys told the social network that he would not leave this story so much. “Marius will return home, and we will finally ventilate the Russian business culture,” he wrote.
It is planned that the plane from Akaba will land in Vilnius on Thursday at about 1 p.m. Lithuanian time.
As BNS wrote, this evacuating flight due to the aircraft repair and complex aviation conditions in the region has been repeatedly delayed. According to the original plan, Lithuanians had to leave Akaba Airport on Tuesday night.
A trip from Jordan to Lithuania should cost about 200 thousand. euros. Lithuanian Prime Minister Gintautas Paluckas assured on Tuesday that Lithuanian citizens would not have to pay for evacuation.
The three -quarters of this amount will be expected to compensate for the European Union due to the activated civil protection mechanism and the other will be covered by the Lithuanian Government.
According to the European Commission, the Community has helped to evacuate more than 400 of its citizens from Israel through Jordan and Egypt. Not only Lithuania, but also Slovakia, Greece and Poland filed such requests.
15min Photo /evacked Lithuanians climb into a plane in Jordan
As previously announced by BNS, Lithuanians crossed the Border of Israel and Jordan Tuesday afternoon. They were forced to leave the Jewish state because of the military conflict between Israel and Iran, with countries for almost a week with rocket firing at each other.
Israel was the first to hit Iran last week, attacking Tehran’s nuclear and military objects and top -ranking officers in arguing for the pursuit of the country’s efforts to make nuclear weapons. Israeli strokes also obstructed residential areas.
Iran, which so far, has responded to Israel’s own missile attacks in the development of nuclear program for civilian purposes.
On Wednesday night, a plane carrying evacuated Lithuanians from Akaba Airport in Jordan to Vilnius removed commentator M. Laurinavičius before takeoff.
